S1.why: Short label under the bracket; 'zadarmo' needs no agreement with a noun, so it stays grammatical whatever the count.

S2.why: An invitation to keep going in the vy form the vocab uses, not a limit message; 15 chars.

S3.s: Využili ste všetkých %lld bezplatných cutlingov. Zostávajú zadarmo a fungujú ďalej.
S3.back: Used you-have all 5 free-of-charge cutlings(gen.pl). They-remain free and they-work further.
S3.why: Item word 'cutling' lowercase in prose as in the vocab; genitive plural fits the fixed 5; second sentence reassures without restating.

S4.why: 'Prvých' frames the free ones as a start rather than a cap; perfective future reads as a promise.

S5.why: The 'X z Y' shape keeps the noun governed by the total, so the used count (0 to 5) never needs its own plural form; same verb as S3.

S6.why: 'Až' carries 'room for up to'; %@ is always 5 000 so genitive plural is right; 18 chars with the number.

S7.s: Uložíte %@ textových a navyše %lld obrázkových cutlingov.
S7.back: You-will-save 5 000 text(adj) and on-top 500 image(adj) cutlings(gen.pl).
S7.why: Uses the vocab's Textový/Obrázkový Cutling as adjectives on one shared noun, so images keep the same item name; 'navyše' makes clear the 500 come in addition.

S8.why: Slovak lists three with no comma before 'a'.

S9.s: Jeden nákup platí všade, kde ste prihlásení do svojho účtu Apple.
S9.back: One purchase is-valid everywhere, where you-are signed-in to your-own account Apple.
S9.why: Follows the vocab's 'prihlásenom do vášho účtu Apple' and Apple's Slovak 'účet Apple'; 'všade' points back at the three devices above.

S11.why: One 'bez' governing three genitives is how a Slovak writer lists absences; 'registrácia' is the everyday word for signing up.

S12.why: The standard App Store action wording in Slovak iOS apps.

S13.why: Reflexive progressive, same noun as S12, ellipsis character.

S14.why: Infinitive as Slovak buttons are written; 'jednorazovo' says pay once; 24 chars plus the price.

S15.why: Same verb as S14 without the price; 8 chars.

S16.why: The wording iOS uses in Slovak for Not Now: putting it off, not refusing.

S17.why: The verb Slovak iOS uses on close buttons.

S18.why: Warm and simple, vy form; 'teraz' ties it to the grid filling the sheet; exactly 20 chars.

S19.s: Vďaka za nákup. Podporili ste Cutling aj človeka, ktorý ho robí sám.
S19.back: Thanks for purchase. Supported you-have Cutling and-also the-person, who it makes alone.
S19.why: 'Vďaka' avoids a 'we' that would contradict one maker; 'robí sám' is how a Slovak says one person builds it.

S20.s: Vitajte späť. Váš nákup je obnovený.
S20.back: Welcome back. Your purchase is restored.
S20.why: Greeting first, then the fact; 'obnovený' matches the Obnoviť nákupy link.

S21.why: A label and value pair reads cleanly in VoiceOver and avoids number agreement on the used count.

S22.why: Reuses the vocab's own count form 'Cutlingov: %lld', which is grammatical for 1, 2, 5 and 21; the room figure needs no noun after it.

S23.s: Cutling je odomknutý. Máte miesto na %@ cutlingov.
S23.back: Cutling is unlocked. You-have room for 5 000 cutlings(gen.pl).
S23.why: App name masculine, so 'odomknutý'; %@ is always 5 000, so genitive plural.

S24.why: Reflexive puts the fault on no one; no period, as an alert title.

S25.s: App Store je momentálne nedostupný. Skúste to o chvíľu znova.
S25.back: App Store is momentarily unavailable. Try it in a-moment again.
S25.why: App Store left undeclined as subject (masculine); 'o chvíľu' is the everyday 'shortly'.

S26.why: One plain fact, App Store as the subject so the person is not blamed.

S27.s: Na účte Apple v tomto zariadení nie je žiadny nákup Cutlingu.
S27.back: On account Apple in this device not is any purchase of-Cutling.
S27.why: Neutral existence statement with no 'you did not buy'; the app name declines to genitive 'Cutlingu' as Slovak does with app names, capital C keeps it apart from the item.

S28.s: Bezplatná verzia pojme %lld cutlingov. Keď Cutling raz odomknete, uložíte si ich, koľko len chcete.
S28.back: Free version holds 5 cutlings(gen.pl). When Cutling once you-unlock, you-will-save yourself them, how-many only you-want.
S28.why: 'Pojme' is the natural verb for what a container holds; 'raz' carries one-time; 'koľko len chcete' is the idiom for as many as you like.

S29.why: Mirrors S1's 'zadarmo' so the two read as one system; 13 chars with digits.

K1.why: Same verb as S3; the capsule is the control, so the infinitive 'Odomknúť' is its action, as Slovak buttons are written; 32 chars.

M1.why: Verb-led infinitive window title, as Slovak macOS names command windows.

M2.why: Same command as M1 with the ellipsis character because it opens a window.

M3.why: Row label in sentence case with the vocab's item word, lowercase as in prose.

M4.why: Compact pair; 'z' is how Slovak reads a count of a total.

M5.why: Masculine agreement with the name; no period on a status value.

M6.s: Jeden nákup odomkne Cutling na iPhone, iPade a Macu.
M6.back: One purchase will-unlock Cutling on iPhone, iPad(loc) and Mac(loc).
M6.why: Device names in the locative as Apple's Slovak writes them: iPhone undeclined, iPade, Macu.

M7.s: Platí na iPhone, iPade a Macu s týmto účtom Apple.
M7.back: Is-valid on iPhone, iPad(loc) and Mac(loc) with this account Apple.
M7.why: M5 above already says unlocked, so this line says where it holds instead of repeating it.

M8.s: Cutling ste si kúpili, ešte keď nebol zadarmo, a tak vám zostáva odomknutý. Vďaka.
M8.back: Cutling you-have yourself bought, still when it-was-not free, and so to-you it-remains unlocked. Thanks.
M8.why: Spoken word order with the reason first; 'Vďaka' as in S19, no 'we'.
